_comment: Resource villages: hamlets spread over the map (placed by scripts/economy/village_placer.gd into server/world/world.json), each working one resource. A village starts held by local militia: `guard` soldiers (base * growth^(level - 1), mixed as `guard_armies`) behind a palisade of palisade_base + palisade_per_level * (level - 1). Beat them and the village is yours, if your keep leaves room for it (`slots`: how many villages each keep level may hold). An owned village sends `yields` (per hour, base * yield_growth^(level - 1)) to your castle; what it holds waits there up to store_hours of yield, and whoever takes the village carries that off. Online, other players can take your village: soldiers you station there defend it, behind the same palisade. A village just taken can't be attacked for peace_hours. Village levels rise towards the middle of the map: `level_rings` are the distances from the centre inside which villages are level 5, 4, 3 and 2.
